observations: Unofficial beat charting through the first seven camp practices (Steelers Depot, published 2026-08-08): 9 receptions on 19 targets (47.4%), 2 TDs, 1 drop; play described as picking up in recent days, with two Rodgers TDs on Tuesday.

2026-08-08 night practice (Latrobe Memorial Stadium): Wilson ran with the first-team offense and was targeted by Aaron Rodgers in team periods (one curl broken up with forceful contact by S Rayshawn Jenkins; at least two catches).

Deployment pattern per Athlon/Yahoo 2026-08-01 (event 07-31, sourced to Steelers Now): Wilson 'has primarily handled the slot and de facto WR3 role with the first-team offense', with some second-team outside work on 07-31.

Context: WR-room injuries opened additional first-unit access in-window — Michael Pittman Jr. right-leg injury 08-08, and both Pittman and DK Metcalf missed the 08-10 and 08-11 practices (Steelers Depot 08-10 injury report; WPXI 08-11).
inferences: Directional mechanism (pre-baseline, preserved as inference): upward pressure on first-team slot routes and targets, amplified while Metcalf/Pittman are unavailable.
The sub-50% charted catch rate tempers any efficiency read: this is access evidence, not efficiency evidence.
